Needless to say, this is probably the most unique band I've ever heard and by far one of the more entertaining bands.

Although Moon Hooch is not my cup of tea, I have come a cross a dozen or so artists on Tiny Desk that I really enjoy. I may not fully appreciate them on the first listen either, so I might come around on these guys down the road.

Welcome to /v/ModForRent! Here we try to serve as a liaison between between new or existing subverses and Voaters who would love the opportunity to moderate a community.

Posting Rules

If you're looking for a moderator for your subverse, please use the "Discuss" function. Your title should include

  • /v/subversename
  • short description
  • how many mods you're looking for

Example: "/v/ModForHire - A community based on helping connect mods and subverses (Looking for 1 moderator!)

Now, in the description box, please show the following

  • self-introduction
  • requirements for moderation
  • preferred method of contact

If you are trying to promote yourself as a possible moderator, please use the "Discuss" function. Your title should include

  • your name
  • explanation of what you're looking for

Example: /u/Drachen is looking for a position in a gaming subverse!

Now, in the description box, please show the following

  • self-introduction
  • your experience with moderation
  • how you would handle certain events such as spam, an aggressive user, harassment, etc.
  • types of subverses you're looking to moderate
  • your availability (what times are you on?)

I'm looking forward to helping out both sides of the community!
